senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. Ges. H. Dict.10 s. v. פַּרְבָּר; cmp., however, [open place,] outwork, court, market.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Challah 4:11">Ḥall. IV, 11</cite> <he>הקונה בסוריא כקונה בפ׳ שבירושלים</he> Mish. ed. (Bab. ed. <he>בפַרְוָוד</he>; Y. ed. <he>בפַרְוַוד ירוש׳</he>; Ms. M. <he>בפַרְוָורֵי</he>) he who owns land in Syria is under the same obligations as if he owned land in the outskirts of Jerusalem; <cite ref="Gittin 8b:1">Gitt. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>בפַרְוָארֵי</he>); <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 2:10">Tosef. Ter. II, 10</cite> <cite ref="Q01610"><he>פרואר</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>פרוארי</he>, <cite ref="Q01623"><he>פרוד</he></cite>; <he>פרוזדר</he>, corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 7:6">Tosef. Ab. Zar. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:10">VIII</cite>), 10 <he>פרואר שישראל וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>פרזר</he>, <he>פרזא</he>, corr. acc.) a market to which an Israelite and a gentile bring wine; Y. ib. IV, end, 44ᵇ <he>פרכיי׳ של עיר</he> (read: <he>פּרְבָּרָהּ</he>, or <cite ref="Q01639"><he>פַּרְוָורָהּ</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68:14">Gen. R. s. 68</cite> <he>עולים … יושב ודן ויוצאין בפרווד ומוצאים אותו ישן</he> (some ed. <he>בפַרְוָד</he>; Ar. <he>בפרוור</he> a. with differ. version) they go up to the forum and find him (the king) sitting in judgment; they come out to the outskirts (his country seat) and find him asleep; a. e.—Pl. <he>פַּרְוָורִים</he>, constr. <cite ref="Q01638"><he>פַּרְוָורֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01610"><he>פַּרְוָארֵי</he></cite>, v. supra.
